# herdr's own test data

`legacy-pre-tabs-v2.json` is copied unchanged from herdr's repository
(`tests/fixtures/session/legacy-pre-tabs-v2.json`, github.com/herdrdev/herdr,
Apache-2.0). It is a version-2 `session.json` in the pre-tabs workspace shape
(`layout` + `panes`, no `id`, no `identity_cwd`) that herdr 0.9.5 still parses
(`src/persist/snapshot.rs`, `migrate_workspace`). Nothing in this folder is
hand-written.
